items.title: Return signed Nutzungsvertrag
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns ein unterschriebenes Exemplar innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zurück; mitgezählt werden Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonntage und Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 04.07.2025, the 'event' starting the period. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the starting day itself is not counted, so counting begins Sat 05.07.2025. The letter defines the period as 'Werktage' counting Monday-Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays (no NRW holidays fall in this window). Counting 14 such days from 05.07.2025: 05.07(Sat)=1, 07.07(Mon)=2, 08.07=3, 09.07=4, 10.07=5, 11.07=6, 12.07(Sat)=7, 14.07(Mon)=8, 15.07=9, 16.07=10, 17.07=11, 18.07=12, 19.07(Sat)=13, 21.07(Mon)=14. Day 14 falls on Monday 21.07.2025, a working day, so no further adjustment under §193 BGB is needed.

warnings: If the signed contract copy is not received by the deadline, the cooperative states it will reassign the apartment to the next member on the waiting list ('Geht der Vertrag nicht rechtzeitig ein, vergeben wir die Wohnung an das nächste Mitglied auf der Warteliste'); the exact start of the 14-Werktage count ('ab dem Datum dieses Briefes') is slightly ambiguous as to whether the letter's own date counts as day one, so the due date is given as medium confidence (earliest plausible reading would be one working day earlier, Saturday 19.07.2025, which is not a working day for return purposes and would itself shift).
